body:
## Pull request overview

Addresses CI test failures caused by an incompatible `react-markdown` prop usage and a mismatched ReportViewer toolbar expectation, aligning implementation and tests with current library/component behavior.

**Changes:**
- Fix `ChatbotEnhanced` markdown rendering by wrapping `<ReactMarkdown>` in a styled `<div>` instead of passing the deprecated `className` prop.
- Update `ReportViewer` test to assert the actual export button label (“PDF”) rather than the outdated “Export”.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportViewer.test.tsx | Updates toolbar assertion to match current export button label (“PDF”). |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx | Removes deprecated `className` prop usage on `ReactMarkdown` by applying prose classes to a wrapper element. |
